source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Centralize important decisions and limit staff participation because servant leadership depends on clear control by the formal leader.","B":"Prioritize the leader’s recognition over team development when the two goals conflict because status reinforces authority.","C":"Support staff growth and well-being, share appropriately in decisions, and develop team members while remaining accountable for leadership outcomes.","D":"Avoid difficult leadership decisions and transfer responsibility for unit outcomes to frontline staff so the leader does not dominate."}}
source_row.rationale: Open RN describes servant leadership as focusing on growth and well-being of team members, sharing decision-making, and developing team members to their highest potential.
